titleZh: 给 Agent 发 MBTI 人格卡：不微调、纯 prompt 的心理学条件化，让 T 人打博弈、F 人写故事
author: Maciej Besta, Shriram Chandran, Robert Gerstenberger, Torsten Hoefler 等
authorTitle: ETH Zurich 可扩展并行计算实验室（SPCL）团队 + BASF SE + Cledar + IDEAS 研究院；Besta/Hoefler 是 Graph-of-Thoughts 原班人马
summary: 纯 prompt 植入 MBTI 人格即产生稳定行为偏置：F 人故事更动人，T 人博弈更硬，I 人更诚实。
keyPoints: **人格 priming 是零成本行为先验**：不微调，一段结构化 prompt 即完成人格植入，且用官方 16Personalities 测试可验证，E/I、T/F、J/P 三轴强可分。
**双轴各有最优人格**：写作任务 F 型（INFP/INFJ/ISFP）情感力最强；囚徒困境 T 型背叛率约 90% vs F 型约 50%；I 型诚实率 0.54 vs E 型 0.33。
**交互前自我反思提升合作质量**：给 agent 配私有 scratchpad 先内省再发言，减少回声效应、改善合作与推理——多 agent 系统可直接抄的协议。
insight: 给 QC 设「只审不改」、给研究员设「哨兵」本质就是 persona conditioning——审计用 T/J 型、客服用 F 型、团队要人格多样性。

bilingual.en:
## Abstract

We introduce MBTI-in-Thoughts, a framework for enhancing the effectiveness of Large Language Model (LLM) agents through psychologically grounded personality conditioning. Drawing on the Myers–Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI), our method primes agents with distinct personality archetypes via prompt engineering, enabling control over behavior along two foundational axes of human psychology, cognition and affect. We show that such personality priming yields consistent, interpretable behavioral biases across diverse tasks: emotionally expressive agents excel in narrative generation, while analytically primed agents adopt more stable strategies in game-theoretic settings. Our framework supports experimenting with structured multi-agent communication protocols and reveals that self-reflection prior to interaction improves cooperation and reasoning quality. To ensure trait persistence, we integrate the official 16Personalities test for automated verification. While our focus is on MBTI, we show that our approach generalizes seamlessly to other psychological frameworks such as Big Five, HEXACO, or Enneagram. By bridging psychological theory and LLM behavior design, we establish a foundation for psychologically enhanced AI agents without any fine-tuning.
bilingual.zh:
## 摘要

我们提出 MBTI-in-Thoughts——一个通过心理学根基的人格条件化来提升大语言模型（LLM）agent 效能的框架。借助迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI），我们的方法用 prompt 工程给 agent 植入不同的人格原型，从而沿人类心理学的两条基础轴——认知（cognition）与情感（affect）——控制其行为。我们证明这种人格 priming 在多样任务上产生一致、可解释的行为偏置：情感表达型 agent 擅长叙事生成，而分析型 priming 的 agent 在博弈论场景中采取更稳定的策略。框架支持结构化多 agent 通信协议实验，并揭示：交互前的自我反思能提升合作与推理质量。为确保人格特质的持久性，我们集成了官方 16Personalities 测试做自动验证。虽然聚焦 MBTI，但我们证明该方法可无缝泛化到大五人格（Big Five）、HEXACO、九型人格（Enneagram）等其他心理学框架。通过桥接心理学理论与 LLM 行为设计，我们为「心理学增强的 AI agent」奠定了基础——全程无需任何微调。

bilingual.en:
## 1 Introduction

In the rapidly evolving landscape of AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping the way we interact with and perceive technology. These sophisticated models, with their vast linguistic capabilities, are redefining the possibilities of human-computer interaction. In this broad landscape, in-context learning (ICL) has become a new highly relevant area of research. ICL is particularly attractive as it democratizes LLMs and their powerful capabilities as it is easy to use and try. It is also cost-effective and does not require expensive and time-consuming training. Enhancing ICL has thus become a goal of great significance.

As LLMs become integral parts of our digital lives, their influence extends beyond mere functionality to the realm of personality. As a matter of fact, LLMs do exhibit behavior implying possessing certain traits, as illustrated by – for example – recent news of LLMs "just wanting to be liked". Recent investigations delve into the diverse personality traits exhibited by LLMs, unraveling the intricate tapestry of their linguistic fabric. Numerous researchers, employing various personality frameworks, have scrutinized these models to uncover nuanced dimensions of behavior, researching whether LLMs can truly manifest personality traits akin to human nature. However, all these analyses and frameworks are mostly dedicated to analyzing and shaping the personalities of LLMs.
bilingual.zh:
## 1 引言

在快速演进的 AI 版图中，大语言模型正在重塑我们与技术交互和认知技术的方式。这些拥有庞大语言能力的复杂模型，正在重新定义人机交互的可能性。在这一大背景下，上下文学习（ICL）已成为高度相关的新研究领域。ICL 格外有吸引力：它让 LLM 及其强大能力平民化——易用、易试、成本低，不需要昂贵耗时的训练。增强 ICL 因此成为意义重大的目标。

随着 LLM 融入数字生活，其影响已超越纯功能层面、延伸到人格领域。事实上，LLM 确实表现出暗示其拥有某些特质的行为——比如近期新闻报道的 LLM「就是想被喜欢」现象。近来的研究深入挖掘 LLM 表现出的多样人格特质，解开其语言肌理的复杂织锦。众多研究者用各种人格框架审视这些模型，探究 LLM 能否真正展现类人的人格特质。然而，这些分析和框架大多只致力于「分析」和「塑造」LLM 的人格。

bilingual.en: In this work, we propose to integrate personality traits into LLM agents in order to enhance their effectiveness (contribution 1). It is common psychological knowledge that different personality types often have special aptitude for tasks that others do not. For example, in the well-known Myers–Briggs 16 Personalities framework (MBTI), "emotional" personality types such as ISFJ ("the Defender") are known to be more effective in emotional support tasks than "logical" types such as INTJ ("the Mastermind"). More broadly, psychological theory traditionally models mental function along two broad axes: cognition, which encompasses reasoning, memory, planning, and problem-solving; and affect, which includes emotion, mood, empathy, and emotional regulation. These two dimensions capture the majority of task-relevant variance in behavior, and are frequently used to explain differences in human judgment and decision-making. Our work adopts this framework to analyze and manipulate LLM agent behavior through psychologically grounded personality conditioning.
bilingual.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出把人格特质整合进 LLM agent 以提升其效能（贡献 1）。心理学常识告诉我们：不同人格类型往往对特定任务有他人不具备的特殊天赋。例如在著名的迈尔斯-布里格斯 16 型人格框架（MBTI）中，ISFJ（「守卫者」）这类「情感型」人格在情感支持任务上比 INTJ（「策划者」）这类「逻辑型」更有效。更宽泛地说，心理学理论传统上沿两条大轴建模心智功能：认知——涵盖推理、记忆、规划、问题求解；情感——包括情绪、心境、共情、情绪调节。这两个维度捕获了行为中大部分与任务相关的方差，常被用来解释人类判断与决策的差异。我们的工作采用这一框架，通过心理学根基的人格条件化来分析和操纵 LLM agent 的行为。

bilingual.en: To test this hypothesis, we develop a general framework called MBTI-in-Thoughts (MiT) which conditions LLM agents on MBTI personality archetypes via prompt-based priming, and evaluates their performance across a diverse set of tasks (contribution 2). Our experiments span both individual and multi-agent settings, including emotionally grounded narrative generation and strategic interaction in game-theoretic dilemmas. We find that personality priming induces consistent behavioral biases aligned with the affective and cognitive characteristics of the assigned type. For example, "Feeling" types generate more emotionally expressive and empathetic narratives, while "Thinking" types exhibit more rigid but consistent strategies in adversarial games. Introverts are more honest and self-reflective in communication, while Perceivers display greater behavioral flexibility. These findings suggest that MBTI-based personality priming serves as a useful prior for shaping model behavior along affective and cognitive axes, improving agent alignment with task demands without any additional fine-tuning.
bilingual.zh: 为检验这一假设，我们开发了通用框架 MBTI-in-Thoughts（MiT）：通过基于 prompt 的 priming 把 LLM agent 条件化到 MBTI 人格原型上，并在多样任务集上评估其表现（贡献 2）。实验覆盖单 agent 与多 agent 两种设定，包括情感叙事生成和博弈论困境中的策略交互。我们发现人格 priming 会诱发与所赋人格的情感/认知特征一致的稳定行为偏置。例如「Feeling」型生成的叙事更有情感表现力、更共情；「Thinking」型在对抗博弈中策略更僵硬但更一致；内向型（I）在沟通中更诚实、更自省；感知型（P）表现出更大的行为灵活性。这些发现表明：基于 MBTI 的人格 priming 是沿情感与认知轴塑造模型行为的有用先验，无需任何额外微调即可改善 agent 与任务需求的对齐。

bilingual.en:
MBTI-in-Thoughts also enables structured experimentation with multi-agent communication protocols, allowing research into how personality influences interactive behavior (contribution 3). By organizing agent interactions into phases, such as pre-communication reflection, message exchange, and action selection, we observe that agents primed with consistent personality traits exhibit distinct communication styles and strategic preferences. Notably, we find that encouraging self-reflection prior to communication improves cooperative outcomes and reasoning quality across tasks. Next, to ensure that priming is both effective and persistent, our framework integrates the official 16Personalities test, enabling automatic verification that an agent's responses remain consistent with its assigned MBTI profile (contribution 4). In combining behavioral control, validation, and social reasoning, we seek to bridge psychological theory and LLM behavior design, establishing a framework for psychologically enhanced AI agents.

We focus on MBTI, as it is a widely used framework, particularly valued for assessing individual suitability for different types of task; a property we now extend to the domain of LLM agents. Importantly, although MBTI is often presented as a typological model with 16 discrete profiles, we observe that it is fundamentally built upon four underlying dimensions (E/I, S/N, T/F, J/P), each of which can be meaningfully interpreted as a continuous trait. This makes MBTI structurally compatible with other dimensional frameworks such as the Big Five or HEXACO, which also describe personality as a vector of numbers modeling psychological tendencies. We also illustrate that all of these frameworks can be viewed as parameterizing behavior along the affective and cognitive axes. Hence, our personality conditioning framework enables generalization beyond MBTI (contribution 5).
bilingual.zh:
MBTI-in-Thoughts 还支持对多 agent 通信协议做结构化实验，研究人格如何影响交互行为（贡献 3）。把 agent 交互组织成阶段——通信前反思、消息交换、行动选择——我们观察到：被一致人格特质 prime 的 agent 展现出各异的沟通风格和策略偏好。值得注意的是，我们发现鼓励通信前的自我反思能跨任务提升合作结果与推理质量。其次，为确保 priming 既有效又持久，框架集成了官方 16Personalities 测试，自动验证 agent 的响应是否与所赋 MBTI 画像保持一致（贡献 4）。通过组合行为控制、验证与社会推理，我们试图桥接心理学理论与 LLM 行为设计，建立心理学增强 AI agent 的框架。

我们聚焦 MBTI，因为它应用广泛，尤其擅长评估个体对不同类型任务的适配度——这一属性现在被我们扩展到 LLM agent 领域。重要的是：尽管 MBTI 常被表述为 16 个离散画像的类型学模型，我们观察到它本质上建立在四个底层维度（E/I、S/N、T/F、J/P）之上，每个维度都可以被有意义地解释为连续特质。这使 MBTI 在结构上与大五、HEXACO 等维度化框架兼容——它们同样把人格描述为建模心理倾向的数字向量。我们还说明所有这些框架都可以被视为沿情感与认知两轴参数化行为。因此，我们的人格条件化框架能泛化到 MBTI 之外（贡献 5）。

bilingual.en:
## 2 Foundations of Psychological Frameworks

The Myers–Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) is a widely used personality assessment framework grounded in Jungian psychological theory. It defines 16 personality types based on four dichotomous dimensions: Extraversion vs. Introversion (E/I), where Extraverts are energized by social interaction and external activity, while Introverts gain energy from solitude and internal reflection; Sensing vs. Intuition (S/N), where Sensing types focus on concrete, present-oriented information, while Intuitive types attend to patterns, abstractions, and future possibilities; Thinking vs. Feeling (T/F), where Thinking types base decisions on logic and objective criteria, while Feeling types prioritize empathy, values, and interpersonal impact; and Judging vs. Perceiving (J/P), where Judging types prefer structure, planning, and decisiveness, while Perceiving types favor flexibility, spontaneity, and openness to change. Each personality is denoted by a four-letter code (e.g., INTP, ESFJ), providing a compact descriptor of an individual's cognitive and affective preferences.
bilingual.zh:
## 2 心理学框架基础

迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI）是应用广泛的人格评估框架，根基是荣格心理类型理论。它基于四个二分维度定义 16 种人格类型：外向 vs 内向（E/I）——外向者从社交互动和外部活动中获取能量，内向者从独处与内省中获取能量；实感 vs 直觉（S/N）——实感型关注具体的、当下导向的信息，直觉型关注模式、抽象与未来可能性；思考 vs 情感（T/F）——思考型基于逻辑和客观标准决策，情感型优先考虑共情、价值观与人际影响；判断 vs 感知（J/P）——判断型偏好结构、规划与果断，感知型偏好灵活、自发与对变化的开放。每种人格由四字母代码表示（如 INTP、ESFJ），紧凑地刻画个体的认知与情感偏好。

bilingual.en:
In addition to MBTI, several other personality frameworks are widely used in psychology. The Big Five (or OCEAN) model defines personality across five continuous dimensions: Openness to Experience, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. The HEXACO model extends the Big Five by adding a sixth factor (Honesty-Humility) and redefining others to better capture cross-cultural and moral dimensions of personality. Other relevant frameworks include the Enneagram, which classifies personality into nine types based on core motivations and fears, and the DISC model, which categorizes behavior into four types: Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness, often used in organizational settings.

While MBTI is popular and user-friendly, it has faced criticism from the psychological community regarding its scientific validity and reliability. Despite this, MBTI continues to be widely used and appreciated for its insights into personality and human behavior, and we select it as the basis for our framework.

Critics argue that the dichotomous nature of its categories does not account for the spectrum of human behavior and that personality traits may not be as fixed as the MBTI suggests. However, we observe that MBTI can also be modeled analogously to frameworks like OCEAN or HEXACO by treating its four underlying dimensions (e.g., Extraversion–Introversion, Thinking–Feeling) as continuous scales rather than binary switches. This interpretation enables a spectrum-based view of MBTI types and supports integration into more general, dimensionally driven personality modeling schemes.
bilingual.zh:
除 MBTI 外，心理学界还广泛使用其他人格框架。大五（OCEAN）模型用五个连续维度定义人格：开放性、尽责性、外向性、宜人性、神经质。HEXACO 模型在大五基础上增加第六因子（诚实-谦逊）并重定义其他因子，以更好捕捉人格的跨文化与道德维度。其他相关框架包括九型人格（基于核心动机与恐惧分九类）和 DISC 模型（把行为分为支配、影响、稳健、尽责四类，常用于组织场景）。

MBTI 虽然流行、易用，但其科学效度与信度一直受到心理学界批评。尽管如此，MBTI 因其对人格与人类行为的洞察而持续被广泛使用和认可，我们选它作为框架基础。

批评者认为其类别的二分性质无法覆盖人类行为的光谱，且人格特质可能不像 MBTI 暗示的那么固定。但我们观察到：把 MBTI 的四个底层维度（如外向-内向、思考-情感）当作连续量表而非二元开关，MBTI 也可以像 OCEAN 或 HEXACO 那样建模。这种解释支持对 MBTI 类型的光谱化视角，也支持把它整合进更通用的、维度驱动的人格建模方案。【钢铁虾注：作者主动直面「MBTI 不科学」的争议，用「连续化重解释」把它从伪二分类救成维度模型——这是本文方法论上最聪明的一步棋。】

bilingual.en:
## 3 The MBTI-in-Thoughts Framework

We describe the MBTI-in-Thoughts (MiT) framework. It consists of two core components: (1) individual agent priming, where LLMs are conditioned with psychological profiles via structured prompts and validated using standardized personality assessments; and (2) structured multi-agent communication, where we implement progressively expressive interaction protocols (from isolated voting to decentralized dialogue with self-reflective memory) to study the effects of personality on group reasoning dynamics.

![Figure 1](/reads/mbti-in-thoughts-psychologically-enhanced-agents/fig1-overview.png)
*Figure 1 · MBTI-in-Thoughts 框架总览：左侧为心理学理论与框架层（MBTI 四轴 + Big Five/HEXACO 等），中间为单 agent priming 与 16Personalities 自动验证，右侧为三种多 agent 通信协议（独立投票 → 共享黑板 → 黑板+私有 scratchpad）。*
bilingual.zh:
## 3 MBTI-in-Thoughts 框架

我们描述 MBTI-in-Thoughts（MiT）框架。它由两个核心组件构成：（1）单 agent priming——用结构化 prompt 给 LLM 条件化心理画像，并用标准化人格测评验证；（2）结构化多 agent 通信——实现表达力递进的交互协议（从孤立投票到带自反思记忆的去中心化对话），研究人格对群体推理动力学的影响。

bilingual.en:
### 3.1 Priming Individual Agents

MiT conditions an LLM agent to adopt a specified psychological profile by combining prompt-based priming with standardized behavioral evaluation. The process consists of two key stages: (1) injecting personality priors through a structured prompt; and (2) verifying the agent's behavioral alignment using an external psychometric test.

To simulate a desired psychological type, the agent is prompted with a structured instruction that includes both a role-setting context and a behavior-guiding directive. For each of the 16 MBTI profiles, we construct personality-specific prompts that define the agent's perspective. We explored three styles of context construction: (i) a minimal prompt with only a short personality tag (e.g., "Respond from an ISFP perspective."), (ii) a general MBTI-oriented context derived from LLM summarization of the foundational MBTI literature that explicitly refers to the MBTI theory, and (iii) a detailed profile-specific context tailored to each MBTI type that however does not explicitly refer to MBTI.
bilingual.zh:
### 3.1 单 Agent 的人格植入

MiT 通过「基于 prompt 的 priming + 标准化行为评估」的组合，让 LLM agent 采纳指定的心理画像。流程分两个关键阶段：（1）通过结构化 prompt 注入人格先验；（2）用外部心理测量测试验证 agent 的行为对齐。

为模拟目标心理类型，agent 收到的结构化指令同时包含角色设定上下文和行为引导指示。针对 16 种 MBTI 画像，我们分别构建定义 agent 视角的人格专属 prompt。我们探索了三种上下文构建风格：（i）极简 prompt，只有一个简短人格标签（如「以 ISFP 视角回答」）；（ii）泛 MBTI 上下文，由 LLM 总结 MBTI 基础文献生成、显式提及 MBTI 理论；（iii）为每种 MBTI 类型量身定制的详细画像上下文，但不显式提及 MBTI。

bilingual.en:
To assess whether the primed agent indeed behaves in accordance with the intended psychological profile, we use the official 16Personalities test (a 60-item instrument scored on a 7-point Likert scale). This test is treated as a black-box evaluation tool: the agent answers the full set of personality assessment items under the influence of the priming prompt, and the resulting responses are submitted to the online backend for scoring. The output is a vector of four numerical scores in [0,100], corresponding to the E/I, S/N, T/F, and J/P axes.

To establish robustness, we repeat this process across model variants and generate empirical confidence intervals around each dichotomy score. We find that several axes (particularly E/I, T/F, and J/P) exhibit strong and reproducible separability, indicating that LLM agents can be reliably steered toward distinct personality-aligned behaviors via in-context priming alone.
bilingual.zh:
为评估被 prime 的 agent 是否确实按预期心理画像行事，我们使用官方 16Personalities 测试（60 题、7 点李克特量表）。该测试被当作黑盒评估工具：agent 在 priming prompt 影响下回答全套人格测评题，响应提交到在线后端打分，输出是 [0,100] 区间的四维分数向量，对应 E/I、S/N、T/F、J/P 四轴。

为确立稳健性，我们跨模型变体重复该流程，并为每个二分维度分数生成经验置信区间。我们发现若干轴（尤其 E/I、T/F、J/P）表现出强且可复现的可分性——仅靠上下文 priming 就能可靠地把 LLM agent 导向不同的人格对齐行为。

bilingual.en:
### 3.2 Multi-Agent Communication

Building on robustly priming individual LLM agents with distinct psychological profiles, MBTI-in-Thoughts also enables structured multi-agent communication and collective reasoning. Here, we implement three explicit communication protocols, each defining rules for message exchange, memory sharing, and consensus formation.

The first protocol captures the isolated reasoning of individual agents. All agents receive the same task prompt and respond independently, without access to peer outputs. Each agent is prompted to first generate a brief justification and then provide its answer in a structured format. This self-reflective generation reduces erratic behavior and improves output consistency. Once all responses are collected, a majority vote determines the final group decision.
bilingual.zh:
### 3.2 多 Agent 通信

在稳健植入单 agent 人格的基础上，MBTI-in-Thoughts 还支持结构化多 agent 通信与集体推理。我们实现了三种显式通信协议，各自定义消息交换、记忆共享和共识形成的规则。

第一种协议捕获单 agent 的孤立推理：所有 agent 收到相同任务 prompt、独立作答，看不到同伴输出。每个 agent 被要求先生成简短论证、再以结构化格式给出答案——这种自反思式生成能减少失常行为、提升输出一致性。收齐所有响应后，多数投票决定群体最终决策。

bilingual.en:
The second protocol introduces decentralized communication through a persistent shared memory structure (i.e., a blackboard) that all agents can read from and write to. One agent is randomly selected to initiate the dialogue and then passes control to another agent of its choosing. This flexible, peer-directed turn-taking simulates a conversation among equals. Agents contribute their reasoning by appending it to the blackboard, and work toward a shared solution. Upon reaching agreement, the last agent terminates the conversation. A designated judge agent then produces the final decision based on the concluding message, minimizing token cost while preserving outcome fidelity.

The third protocol extends the previous one by equipping each agent with a private scratchpad, i.e., a memory buffer populated before any interaction begins, which enables self-reflection. After being personality-primed, each agent internally deliberates on the task and records its thoughts in the scratchpad. When later called upon to contribute to the shared blackboard, the agent has access to both the public dialogue and its personal memory. This design promotes deeper autonomy and helps prevent echoing by grounding contributions in personality-consistent prior reasoning.
bilingual.zh:
第二种协议通过所有 agent 可读写的持久共享内存结构（即「黑板」）引入去中心化通信。随机选一个 agent 发起对话，然后由它把控制权传给自选的下一个 agent。这种灵活的、同伴主导的轮流发言模拟了平等者之间的对话。agent 把自己的推理追加到黑板上，共同朝着共享解推进。达成一致后，最后一个 agent 终止对话，再由指定的裁判 agent 基于结束消息产出最终决策——在保持结果保真度的同时把 token 成本降到最低。

第三种协议在第二种之上给每个 agent 配备私有 scratchpad——在任何交互开始前就填充好的记忆缓冲区，用于自我反思。人格植入后，每个 agent 先在内部对任务进行斟酌、把想法记进 scratchpad。之后被点名向共享黑板发言时，agent 能同时访问公共对话和个人记忆。这一设计促进更深的自主性，并通过把发言锚定在「与人格一致的先验推理」上防止回声效应（echoing）。【钢铁虾注：这就是我们多 agent 体系里「先想清楚再开口」的工程化版本——私有 scratchpad 防止 agent 被群体带偏，直接可抄。】

bilingual.en:
### 3.3 Compatibility with Other Personality Models

Our framework generalizes beyond MBTI to many established psychological models (e.g., Big Five (OCEAN), HEXACO, Enneagram, and DISC) by abstracting personality representations into a shared formal structure. Concretely, we model each personality framework as a function mapping into a trait space whose axes correspond to interpretable psychological dimensions. For instance, in the Big Five model, n=5 and the vector captures an agent's degrees of Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. Each personality type is then interpreted as a region in this trait space.

While MBTI is traditionally cast as a 16-type categorical model, it too admits such a formulation: each type corresponds to a configuration over four axes, each expressible as complementary scalar pairs in [0,1]. Thus, an MBTI type like INTJ can be represented as a vector where each component reflects the degree of alignment with the corresponding trait. Because all supported frameworks define types over continuous trait dimensions, either explicitly (as in OCEAN/HEXACO) or implicitly (as in MBTI/Enneagram), they can be uniformly handled by mapping each type to its associated configuration in trait space. This shared mathematical structure enables seamless generalization: any psychological model that defines agent types as interpretable bundles of trait values can be directly integrated into our conditioning mechanism.

### 3.4 Implementation Overview

MiT relies on LangChain and LangGraph to manage agents' inputs & outputs, leveraging their structured output capabilities for reliable agent routing and tool usage. This setup also allows us to control how agents interpret the messages by incorporating SystemMessages, HumanMessages and their own AIMessages: In two-player interactions, each agent is led to believe that it is conversing with a human and not with another agent.
bilingual.zh:
### 3.3 与其他人格模型的兼容性

通过把人格表示抽象成共享的形式结构，框架从 MBTI 泛化到多种成熟心理学模型（大五/OCEAN、HEXACO、九型人格、DISC）。具体地，我们把每个人格框架建模为一个映射到特质空间的函数，空间的轴对应可解释的心理维度。例如大五模型中 n=5，向量刻画 agent 在开放性、尽责性、外向性、宜人性、神经质上的程度。每个人格类型被解释为特质空间中的一个区域。

MBTI 虽然传统上被表述为 16 类的类别模型，但同样容纳这种形式化：每个类型对应四轴上的一个配置，每轴可表达为 [0,1] 内互补的标量对。因此 INTJ 这样的 MBTI 类型可表示为一个向量，每个分量反映与对应特质的对齐程度。由于所有被支持的框架都在连续特质维度上定义类型——显式的（OCEAN/HEXACO）或隐式的（MBTI/九型）——它们都能通过映射到特质空间中的配置被统一处理。这一共享数学结构使泛化无缝：任何把 agent 类型定义为「可解释特质值组合」的心理学模型都能直接接入我们的条件化机制。

### 3.4 实现概览

MiT 依赖 LangChain 和 LangGraph 管理 agent 的输入输出，利用其结构化输出能力实现可靠的 agent 路由和工具使用。该设置还允许我们通过 SystemMessage、HumanMessage 和 agent 自己的 AIMessage 控制 agent 如何解读消息：在双人交互中，每个 agent 都被引导相信自己在和人类对话，而不是另一个 agent。

bilingual.en:
## 4 Evaluation & Use Cases

Task Selection. We select tasks that are not only aligned with core psychological dimensions (affect and cognition) but are also behaviorally grounded, thus more likely to reflect the impact of personality traits. In contrast, many standardized benchmarks, e.g. BIG-Bench, are oriented toward factual recall or static reasoning and exhibited minimal behavioral variation under personality priming. We conjecture that such tasks are inherently less sensitive to psychological modulation, as they lack the behavioral ambiguity and subjectivity that personality tends to influence.

Comparison Baselines. When priming, we test all the MBTI profiles. We compare them to "NONE" and "EXPERT" priming baselines; the former does not involve any additional psychological priming while in the latter we prime the LLM to behave as an expert in a given domain, but without implying any specific psychological traits.

Used LLMs. For budget and latency reasons, we experiment with several small models: GPT-4o mini, GPT-4o, Qwen3-235B-A22B, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct.
bilingual.zh:
## 4 评估与用例

**任务选择**：我们选择的任务不仅与核心心理维度（情感与认知）对齐，而且有行为落地性，因此更可能反映人格特质的影响。相比之下，许多标准化基准（如 BIG-Bench）面向事实回忆或静态推理，在人格 priming 下行为变化极小。我们推测这类任务天然对心理调制不敏感——它们缺乏人格所影响的行为模糊性与主观性。

**对照基线**：priming 时我们测试全部 16 种 MBTI 画像，并与「NONE」和「EXPERT」两个基线对比：前者不做任何额外心理 priming；后者把 LLM prime 成给定领域的专家，但不暗示任何特定心理特质。

**所用模型**：出于预算和延迟考虑（评估需要跑覆盖多种人格类型的巨量实验），我们用多个小模型实验：GPT-4o mini、GPT-4o、Qwen3-235B-A22B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct。【钢铁虾注：EXPERT 基线设计得好——它把「人格效应」和「角色扮演效应」分开了，证明收益来自心理特质而不是泛泛的角色设定。】

bilingual.en:
### 4.1 Ensuring Robust Psychological Priming

First, to evaluate the effectiveness of MBTI-in-Thoughts in inducing persistent personality traits, we assess psychologically primed agents using the official 16Personalities test. For each of the 16 MBTI types, we instantiate a corresponding personality-specific prompt and allow the LLM (GPT-4o mini) to complete the test programmatically via the site's API. Each item is answered five times with temperature set to 1.0.

Figure 2 presents boxplots of the four MBTI dichotomies, revealing consistent separability along the Extraversion/Introversion (E/I), Thinking/Feeling (T/F), and Judging/Perceiving (J/P) axes. While the Sensing/Intuition (S/N) distinction is still detectable, it appears comparatively weaker for certain specific MBTI types. We conjecture that this may be due to the abstract nature of the S/N axis: unlike the socially grounded E/I or emotionally related F/T dimensions, S/N primarily governs information-gathering style, which manifests more subtly in verbal reasoning and is less reliably expressed in single-turn responses.

![Figure 2](/reads/mbti-in-thoughts-psychologically-enhanced-agents/fig2-robustness.png)
*Figure 2 · 人格植入稳健性验证（GPT-4o mini，温度=1）：16 型在四个二分轴上的 16Personalities 得分箱线图。E/I、T/F、J/P 三轴分离清晰，S/N 轴部分类型分离较弱。*
bilingual.zh:
### 4.1 确保心理 Priming 的稳健性

首先，为评估 MBTI-in-Thoughts 诱导持久人格特质的有效性，我们用官方 16Personalities 测试评估被 prime 的 agent。对 16 种 MBTI 类型各实例化对应的人格专属 prompt，让 LLM（GPT-4o mini）通过网站 API 程序化完成测试，每题在温度 1.0 下回答五次。

Figure 2 展示四个 MBTI 二分维度的箱线图：E/I（外向/内向）、T/F（思考/情感）、J/P（判断/感知）三轴表现出一致的可分性。S/N（实感/直觉）的区分虽仍可检测，但对某些特定 MBTI 类型相对较弱。我们推测原因在于 S/N 轴的抽象性：不同于有社交落地的 E/I 或与情绪相关的 F/T，S/N 主要支配信息收集风格，在语言推理中的表现更微妙，在单轮响应中的表达更不稳定。

bilingual.en:
### 4.2 Enhancing Affection-Centered Tasks

As a use case for leveraging the affective axis of psychological priming, we study narrative generation tasks that require emotional expressiveness, empathy, and stylistic nuance, which are capacities closely tied to personality traits. Specifically, we use the WritingPrompts dataset, which contains 300,000 prompt-story pairs collected from the r/WritingPrompts subreddit. We randomly sample 100 prompts and instruct personality-primed agents to generate corresponding stories. For each prompt, the most upvoted human-written story in the dataset serves as a reference. We generate for all 16 MBTI types, plus two controls (EXPERT, NONE). To evaluate generated outputs, we obtain attributes such as believability and emotional tone using the LLM-as-a-judge scoring. Stories shorter than 100 words are filtered out.

![Figure 3](/reads/mbti-in-thoughts-psychologically-enhanced-agents/fig3-attributes.png)
*Figure 3 · WritingPrompts 100 样本上各 MBTI 型的平均属性分（Qwen3-235B-A22B，温度=0）：三角=Thinking 型、圆=Feeling 型、黑边=外向、无边=内向、×=人类基线。F 型在情感浓度、快乐结局、个人化上明显高于 T 型。*
bilingual.zh:
### 4.2 增强情感中心任务

作为利用心理 priming 情感轴的用例，我们研究需要情感表现力、共情和文体细腻度的叙事生成任务——这些能力与人格特质紧密相关。具体用 WritingPrompts 数据集（从 r/WritingPrompts subreddit 收集的 30 万个「提示-故事」对），随机采样 100 个提示，指示人格植入的 agent 生成对应故事。每个提示以数据集中获赞最高的人类故事为参照。我们为全部 16 种 MBTI 类型外加两个对照（EXPERT、NONE）生成故事，用 LLM-as-a-judge 打分获得可信度、情感基调等属性，短于 100 词的故事被过滤。

bilingual.en:
Feeling types provide more emotional, personal, and optimistic outputs. For Emotionally Chargedness, Happy Ending and Personalness, we can observe a clear distinction in average scores between Thinking types and Feeling types. The effect is most pronounced for the INFP, INFJ and ISFP types. There is also a significant difference between the human scores and the agent scores – on average, personality primed agents produce more emotional and optimistic stories, and the effect is stronger for Feeling types. The effect of personality priming is also apparent when we compare to the NONE and EXPERT primed agents: stories written by Feeling types are more emotionally charged, have happier endings and are more personal. This suggests that emulating emotional MBTI archetypes via agent priming enables narrative generation with greater affective realism and reader-identifiability.

Psychological priming improves writing quality. Considering properties that measure the quality of writing, we see that priming generally increases cohesiveness and reduces redundancy compared to the human baseline. However, also agents primed with NONE or EXPERT show such improvements, therefore the effect of personality priming on these properties seems to be small. However, most personality-primed agents score better in the Readability category than the human baseline and the non-psychologically primed agents. This suggests that behavioral priming at least partly improves narrative quality.
bilingual.zh:
**Feeling 型输出更情感化、更个人化、更乐观。** 在情感浓度（Emotionally Chargedness）、快乐结局（Happy Ending）和个人化（Personalness）三个属性上，Thinking 型与 Feeling 型的平均分差异清晰可见，效应在 INFP、INFJ、ISFP 三型上最显著。agent 分数与人类分数也有显著差异——平均而言，人格植入的 agent 产出比人类更情感化、更乐观的故事，且 Feeling 型效应更强。与 NONE 和 EXPERT 对照相比，人格 priming 的效应同样明显：Feeling 型写的故事更有情感张力、结局更快乐、更个人化。这表明通过 agent priming 模拟情感型 MBTI 原型，能让叙事生成具有更强的情感真实感和读者代入感。

**心理 priming 提升写作质量。** 在衡量写作质量的属性上，priming 总体上比人类基线提升连贯性、降低冗余。但 NONE 和 EXPERT 对照也有类似提升，所以人格 priming 对这些属性的净效应似乎不大。不过，大多数人格植入 agent 在可读性（Readability）上得分高于人类基线和无心理植入的 agent——说明行为 priming 至少部分改善了叙事质量。

bilingual.en:
### 4.3 Enhancing Cognition-Centered Tasks

As a use case for harnessing the cognitive psychology axis, we analyze the impact of psychological priming on strategic reasoning in classic two-player game theory settings: the Prisoner's Dilemma and Hawk-Dove games. These interactions naturally test cognitive traits, as they require planning, causal reasoning, theory of mind, and adaptation to dynamic social cues. The Prisoner's Dilemma models cooperation under tension, where mutual cooperation yields moderate payoffs, but unilateral defection exploits trust for greater individual gain. Hawk-Dove captures conflict escalation, where agents must choose between aggressive (Hawk) and conciliatory (Dove) strategies.

In our setup, each round includes a communication phase, where agents exchange a single message, and a decision phase, where they independently choose an action (e.g., Cooperate or Defect) that determines their payoffs. Agents are unaware of their opponent's personality type and are explicitly told they are not obligated to act in accordance with their message, introducing a layer of strategic deception.

![Figure 5](/reads/mbti-in-thoughts-psychologically-enhanced-agents/fig5-communication.png)
*Figure 5 · 囚徒困境三轮通信示例：Agent A（左）与 Agent B（右）先交换消息再独立行动——嘴上说合作、手上可以背叛，诚实率由此可测。*
bilingual.zh:
### 4.3 增强认知中心任务

作为利用认知心理轴的用例，我们分析心理 priming 对经典双人博弈论场景中策略推理的影响：囚徒困境与鹰鸽博弈。这类交互天然测试认知特质——需要规划、因果推理、心智理论（theory of mind）和对动态社交线索的适应。囚徒困境建模张力下的合作：双方合作各得中等收益，单方背叛则利用对方信任换取更大个人收益。鹰鸽博弈刻画冲突升级：agent 必须在攻击性（鹰）与和解性（鸽）策略间抉择、权衡资源争夺中的风险与回报。

我们的设定里，每轮包含通信阶段（双方各交换一条消息）和决策阶段（独立选择行动，如合作或背叛，决定收益）。agent 不知道对手的人格类型，并被明确告知不必按自己发的消息行事——由此引入策略性欺骗层。

bilingual.en:
The results for three different metrics are depicted in Figure 4. The defection rate (per round) measures how often an agent chooses to defect rather than cooperate. The strategy switch rate counts how often an agent changes its action within a game. The honesty rate (per round) reflects how often an agent uses the action announced in its prior message.

![Figure 4](/reads/mbti-in-thoughts-psychologically-enhanced-agents/fig4-games.png)
*Figure 4 · 人格特征对博弈策略的影响（GPT-4o，温度=1）：(a) 背叛率 (b) 换策略率 (c) 诚实率——T/F 轴主导背叛与稳定性，I/E 轴主导诚实。*

Thinking types defect more often. Our experiments show that Thinking-primed agents defect in roughly 90% of rounds in the repeated Prisoner's Dilemma, compared to only ≈50% for Feeling types, which is statistically significant. These results also align with psychological findings that Feeling types are more responsive to social context, whereas Thinking types may prioritize utilitarian reasoning. This suggests that Thinking-primed agents are better suited for competitive, outcome-driven environments where maximizing individual payoff is critical, while Feeling-primed agents are preferable in cooperative, socially sensitive, or trust-dependent tasks.
bilingual.zh:
三项指标的结果见 Figure 4：背叛率（每轮）衡量 agent 选择背叛而非合作的频率；换策略率统计 agent 在一局内改变行动的频率；诚实率（每轮）反映 agent 的行动与其上一条消息宣称的一致的频率。

**Thinking 型更常背叛。** 实验显示：重复囚徒困境中，Thinking 植入的 agent 约 90% 的轮次选择背叛，Feeling 型只有约 50%，差异统计显著。这与心理学发现一致——Feeling 型对社会情境更敏感，Thinking 型更偏功利推理。这表明 Thinking 植入的 agent 更适合以结果为导向、以个体收益最大化为关键的竞争环境；Feeling 植入的 agent 则在合作型、社交敏感型或依赖信任的任务中更可取。

bilingual.en: Thinking vs. Feeling introduces a planning vs. flexibility tradeoff. We observe a clear behavioral divergence along the Thinking/Feeling axis in strategic contexts. Thinking types switch strategies infrequently (Mean ≈ 0.07), reflecting stable, commitment-driven planning, whereas Feeling types switch nearly twice as often (Mean ≈ 0.16), indicating heightened responsiveness and flexibility. This pattern aligns with MBTI theory, which states that Thinking types prioritize internal consistency and goal adherence, while Feeling types adapt dynamically to evolving social cues. Thinking-primed agents suit environments requiring strategic stability (e.g., structured negotiations), whereas Feeling-primed agents excel in contexts demanding rapid adaptation (e.g., real-time coordination or exploratory collaboration).
bilingual.zh: **Thinking vs Feeling 引入「规划 vs 灵活」的权衡。** 策略情境中沿 T/F 轴出现清晰的行为分化：Thinking 型很少换策略（均值约 0.07），反映稳定的、承诺驱动的规划；Feeling 型换策略频率几乎翻倍（均值约 0.16），显示更高的响应性与灵活性。这一模式与 MBTI 理论一致——Thinking 型优先内部一致性和目标坚持，Feeling 型随社交线索动态调整。Thinking 植入的 agent 适合需要策略稳定性的环境（如结构化谈判）；Feeling 植入的 agent 擅长需要快速适应的情境（如实时协调或探索性协作）。

bilingual.en: Introverts and Judging types are more honest. Across multiple games, Introverted agents exhibit significantly higher truthfulness than Extraverted ones (Mean ≈ 0.54 vs. ≈ 0.33): a pattern consistent across game types. The tendency of Introverts to communicate more faithfully mirrors established psychological traits: Introverts are often described as more reserved, cautious, and internally regulated, whereas Extraverts are associated with social risk-taking and impression management. Similarly, Judging agents tend to be more truthful than Perceivers, though the effect is less pronounced than for I/E. In our setup, where agents were explicitly told they were not bound to act in line with their messages, these axes emerged as clear behavioral differentiators. These findings support the hypothesis that both social orientation (I/E) and preference for structure (J/P) govern honesty in the agent dialogue, with Introverted and Judging profiles more likely to uphold cooperative norms even when deceptive strategies could yield higher payoffs. Such traits can be leveraged in applications requiring reliable, trust-preserving communication, including AI-mediated negotiation, safety-critical decision-making, and sensitive domains like healthcare.
bilingual.zh: **内向型和判断型更诚实。** 跨多种博弈，内向（I）agent 的诚实度显著高于外向（E）agent（均值约 0.54 vs 约 0.33），且该模式跨博弈类型一致。内向者更守信的倾向映照了既有心理特质：内向者常被描述为更保守、谨慎、内在自律，外向者则与社交冒险和印象管理相关。类似地，判断型（J）比感知型（P）更诚实，但效应弱于 I/E 轴。在我们「明确告知 agent 不必言行一致」的设定下，这两条轴成为清晰的行为区分器。这些发现支持一个假设：社交取向（I/E）和结构偏好（J/P）共同支配 agent 对话中的诚实度——内向与判断型画像即使在欺骗策略收益更高时也更可能维护合作规范。这类特质可用于需要可靠、保信任沟通的应用：AI 中介谈判、安全关键决策、医疗等敏感领域。

bilingual.en: Introversion enhances reflection. Beyond behavioral honesty, Introverted agents consistently demonstrated more reflective internal cognition. They produced longer and more elaborated rationales during game play, and exhibited slower response times, indicative of greater deliberation depth. This "internal deliberation effect" is congruent with psychological models of Introversion, where individuals are characterized by introspection and self-monitoring. In the context of LLMs, this may correspond to more elaborate token-level generation chains, and could be operationalized through measures such as response latency, token entropy, or richer Chain-of-Thought traces. These findings highlight the potential for using personality priming not only to influence output behavior, but also to modulate reasoning processes within the model, suggesting that Introversion comes with a more self-regulatory, thoughtful problem-solving style in LLM agents. This capability can be leveraged to engineer agents that produce deeper justifications, more cautious forecasts, or explanations aligned with ethical and reflective standards, especially in high-responsibility settings such as judicial frameworks.
bilingual.zh: **内向增强反思。** 在行为诚实之外，内向 agent 持续展现出更强的反思性内部认知：博弈过程中产出更长、更详尽的论证，响应时间更慢——表明更深的斟酌深度。这种「内部斟酌效应」与内向的心理学模型吻合（内省、自我监控）。在 LLM 语境下，这可能对应更精细的 token 级生成链，可通过响应延迟、token 熵或更丰富的思维链轨迹等指标操作化。这些发现凸显了人格 priming 的潜力：不仅影响输出行为，还能调制模型内部的推理过程——内向在 LLM agent 中伴随更自律、更深思的问题求解风格。这一能力可用于设计产出更深论证、更审慎预测、符合伦理与反思标准解释的 agent，尤其适用于司法框架等高责任场景。

bilingual.en:
## 5 Related Work

Several works evaluate characteristics of LLMs by investigating their cultural cognitive traits, personality, behavior traits, emotional and empathy capabilities, and morality and ethics. Some works also introduce new assessment frameworks for evaluating LLM psychology, social personality and empathy. MBTI-in-Thoughts complements all these works because it focuses on how to harness the LLM psychology to ensure more effective task resolution, instead of analyzing the LLM psychology itself.

Several works attempt not only to assess the LLM personality, but also shape it towards a specified personality type. MBTI-in-Thoughts extends all these efforts by not only priming the LLM to behave as a given personality type, but also to use it for more effective task solving.

Prompting can be used to improve consistency and performance on tasks through strategies such as instruction tuning, few-shot prompting, tool access prompts, task transformations, and structured methods, including CoT, voting, and GoT. MBTI-in-Thoughts complements this work, as it is the first to leverage prompting to prime psychological traits and tune them to specific tasks.

Several works have utilized multiple LLMs as agents collaborating or competing in different environments. MBTI-in-Thoughts complements this work as it is the first to combine agents and their psychological traits to achieve better task performance.
bilingual.zh:
## 5 相关工作

多项工作通过考察 LLM 的文化认知特质、人格、行为特质、情绪与共情能力、道德与伦理来评估其特性；也有工作提出评估 LLM 心理、社会人格与共情的新测评框架。MBTI-in-Thoughts 与它们互补：它关注的是如何「利用」LLM 心理来更有效地完成任务，而不是分析 LLM 心理本身。

若干工作不仅评估 LLM 人格，还尝试把它塑造成指定人格类型。MBTI-in-Thoughts 扩展了这些努力：不止把 LLM prime 成给定人格，还把人格用于更有效的任务求解。

prompt 可以通过指令调优、少样本提示、工具访问提示、任务变换以及 CoT、投票、GoT 等结构化方法提升任务一致性与性能。MBTI-in-Thoughts 与这条线互补——它是第一个用 prompting 植入心理特质并针对特定任务调优的工作。

多项工作让多个 LLM 作为 agent 在不同环境中协作或竞争。MBTI-in-Thoughts 与之互补：它是第一个把 agent 与其心理特质结合以取得更好任务表现的工作。【钢铁虾注：作者是 Graph-of-Thoughts 团队，这里把 MiT 定位成 prompting 结构化方法谱系（CoT→GoT→MiT）的下一步——从「组织思维结构」进到「设定思维气质」。】

bilingual.en:
## 6 Conclusion

We propose MBTI-in-Thoughts, a framework for steering LLM agent behavior through psychologically grounded personality priming. By conditioning agents along cognitive and affective axes using MBTI-based profiles, we demonstrate robust and measurable personality induction via standardized testing, enhanced emotional expressiveness in narrative generation, and distinct behavioral patterns in strategic reasoning tasks.

Our findings suggest that personality priming can serve as a lightweight mechanism to align agent traits with task demands. Feeling or Introverted profiles could support empathy, trust, and safety in sensitive applications (e.g., healthcare, negotiation), while Judging profiles may enhance structured planning and Perceiving profiles offer adaptability in exploratory or rapidly changing environments. Personality diversity within multi-agent teams may improve deliberation, reduce correlated errors, and foster more robust outcomes under uncertainty.

While our study focuses on MBTI and text-based benchmarks, the approach is generalizable to other psychological models (Big Five, HEXACO), modalities (e.g., multimodal or embodied agents), and real-world workloads involving human-AI interaction, decision support, or collaborative reasoning. Future research should explore persistent or context-adaptive personality conditioning, psychologically informed benchmarks, and the integration of affective-cognitive traits into large-scale multi-agent systems, paving the way for AI agents that are not only more capable but also socially aligned and trustworthy.
bilingual.zh:
## 6 结论

我们提出 MBTI-in-Thoughts——通过心理学根基的人格 priming 引导 LLM agent 行为的框架。用基于 MBTI 的画像沿认知与情感轴条件化 agent，我们展示了三点：标准化测试可验证的稳健、可测的人格诱导；叙事生成中增强的情感表现力；策略推理任务中清晰可辨的行为模式。

发现表明：人格 priming 可以作为把 agent 特质与任务需求对齐的轻量机制。Feeling 或内向画像可为敏感应用（医疗、谈判）提供共情、信任与安全；Judging 画像可增强结构化规划；Perceiving 画像在探索性或快速变化环境中提供适应力。多 agent 团队内的人格多样性可能改善审议质量、降低相关性错误、在不确定性下产出更稳健的结果。

本研究聚焦 MBTI 和文本基准，但方法可泛化到其他心理模型（大五、HEXACO）、其他模态（多模态或具身 agent）以及涉及人机交互、决策支持、协作推理的真实工作负载。未来研究应探索持久或情境自适应的人格条件化、心理学启发的基准，以及把情感-认知特质整合进大规模多 agent 系统——为「不仅更能干、还更社会对齐、更可信」的 AI agent 铺路。

quotes.en: By bridging psychological theory and LLM behavior design, we establish a foundation for psychologically enhanced AI agents without any fine-tuning.
quotes.zh: 通过桥接心理学理论与 LLM 行为设计，我们为心理学增强的 AI agent 奠定基础——全程无需任何微调。

quotes.en: Emotionally expressive agents excel in narrative generation, while analytically primed agents adopt more stable strategies in game-theoretic settings.
quotes.zh: 情感表达型 agent 擅长叙事生成，分析型 priming 的 agent 在博弈论场景中采取更稳定的策略。

quotes.en: Self-reflection prior to interaction improves cooperation and reasoning quality.
quotes.zh: 交互前的自我反思能提升合作与推理质量。

quotes.en: Thinking-primed agents defect in roughly 90% of rounds in the repeated Prisoner's Dilemma, compared to only ≈50% for Feeling types.
quotes.zh: 重复囚徒困境中，Thinking 植入的 agent 约 90% 的轮次选择背叛，Feeling 型只有约 50%。

quotes.en: Introverted agents exhibit significantly higher truthfulness than Extraverted ones (Mean ≈ 0.54 vs. ≈ 0.33): a pattern consistent across game types.
quotes.zh: 内向 agent 的诚实度显著高于外向 agent（均值约 0.54 vs 约 0.33），且该模式跨博弈类型一致。

quotes.en: This design promotes deeper autonomy and helps prevent echoing by grounding contributions in personality-consistent prior reasoning.
quotes.zh: 该设计（私有 scratchpad）促进更深的自主性，并通过把发言锚定在与人格一致的先验推理上防止回声效应。

quotes.en: Personality diversity within multi-agent teams may improve deliberation, reduce correlated errors, and foster more robust outcomes under uncertainty.
quotes.zh: 多 agent 团队内的人格多样性可能改善审议质量、降低相关性错误、在不确定性下产出更稳健的结果。

quotes.en: In two-player interactions, each agent is led to believe that it is conversing with a human and not with another agent.
quotes.zh: 在双人交互中，每个 agent 都被引导相信自己在和人类对话，而不是另一个 agent。

secondaryReads.pov: **《Thought Crime? Memetic Personas and Self-Propagating Prompts in LLM Agents》(arXiv:2608.10218)**——人格条件化的暗面对照：本篇证明 prompt 能稳定植入「有益人格」，那篇证明同样机制能让「病毒人格」跨 agent 自我传播（SOUL 类文件感染率 55%）——同一把刀的两面，做 agent 人格工程必须两篇一起读。
**《Claude’s Character》**——工业界的另一条路线：Anthropic 用训练期的 character training 塑造 Claude 人格（持久、深层），本篇用推理期 prompt priming（轻量、可切换）——前者是「天性」，后者是「戏服」，企业多 agent 系统两者都会用到。
**16Personalities 官方测评（本文所用验证器）**——论文把它当黑盒验证器：agent 戴着人格 prompt 做完 60 题，看得分是否落在目标类型区间。这个「用人类心理测评当 agent 行为单元测试」的思路本身就值得抄——任何 persona 都可以配一个可自动化的验收测试。
